title: ASO — Healthcare Management System Reconstruction & Modernization
subtitle: Emergency Recovery, Clean Code PHP OOP & Cloud Migration to AWS
summary: 15-day critical stabilization and complete reconstruction of an enterprise hospital and medical records platform using modern PHP OOP, migrating infrastructure to AWS (EC2, RDS, S3).
overview: The project at ASO consisted of the emergency recovery and subsequent full architectural rebuild of a legacy enterprise management platform for hospitals, outpatient clinics, and electronic health records (EHR) written in Object-Oriented PHP. The original codebase suffered from chronic concurrency bottlenecks, severe component coupling, and recurring database deadlocks, threatening daily clinical operations. The engagement was structured into two strategic phases: a 15-day rapid stabilization to maintain operational continuity, followed by a 10-month deep software engineering overhaul including modular redesign, query optimization, and infrastructure migration to Amazon Web Services (AWS).
responsibilities: Diagnostic & Emergency Stabilization: Identified concurrency bottlenecks and rolled out critical database locking fixes within 15 days.
Reconstruction Engineering: Rebuilt core modules using modern PHP OOP with strict layering (Domain, Service, Data Access).
Database Tuning: Normalized relational schemas, re-indexed high-volume medical tables in MySQL, and eliminated blocking queries.
Cloud Architecture & AWS Migration: Planned and executed AWS deployment utilizing EC2 instances, Amazon RDS (MySQL) for high availability, and S3 for medical attachments.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: High-risk operation refactoring mission-critical hospital software in 24/7 continuous production with zero downtime for medical staff.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Adopted a phased strangle-pattern modernization strategy with automated regression checks and progressive traffic routing per clinical department.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Migrating gigabytes of sensitive historical patient records without integrity loss.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Engineered automated ETL validation and checksum comparison routines prior to cutover to Amazon RDS.
